title: Deep Rock Galactic
provenance: Reported by theeirdna-commits (highball-db#819, #821 and #822, 2026-10-30), Apple M1, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.10.22, DXMT with a 60 fps cap: 5 of 5 after 2 minutes on engine x64-crossover26.3-r27 (Wine 11), 5 of 5 after 12 minutes and 4 of 5 after 25 minutes on x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, frame drops when swarms come even on the lowest settings. Earlier listed from community consensus (AppleGamingWiki, r/macgaming, MacPlay). Not verified by the maintainer. DrGablonski (highball-db#1350, 2026-11-20), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 31 minutes: with async shader compilation on, AVX advertised (also set as ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1) and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes.
notes: Plays on DXMT on an M1 on both engine lines, with frame drops in big swarms even on the lowest settings. Easy Anti-Cheat runs in user space here and does not stop it. A base M4 rated it perfect over 31 minutes with DXMT on the default engine r28 (highball-db#1350).
